summary_en: MFDRNet reconstructs sparse-view X-ray-induced acoustic computed-tomography images without paired ground-truth training data. It combines virtual multi-view masking, multi-scale attention fusion, and an artifact-disentangling block, and is evaluated on phantom, animal, and human datasets under 16- to 128-channel sampling. The work is directly relevant to computational acoustic image reconstruction and real-time dose-imaging systems.

summary_en: This paper addresses the sensitivity and electrode-nonuniformity penalties of transparent-transducer photoacoustic microscopy with two task-specific neural networks: one for denoising and one for aberration correction. Simulated and experimental results show improved structural fidelity, vascular visibility, SNR, and spatial resolution, while supporting lower laser-energy operation and a simpler coaxial acoustic-optical system.
